decided: 2026-11-14: asked to fill women's football's seasons before 2015/16 as far back as a defensible source allows, under the user's request of 2026-11-13 to cover the year gaps in every sport and their approval of 2026-11-09 for computed football ratings from Elo, labelled as computed. Claude chose the rest, which the user has not confirmed: the men's computed World Cup seasons' method (each finalist's strength from its Elo the day after the final by the same line, its XI the squad's most-used players, ordered by their records), the women's World Cups and Olympic tournaments only (Wikidata records too few women's caps to fill the years between), the scale's top and the XI's profile from the built-in women's season, and the Olympic tournament weighed as the World Cup is in the Elo.

elo.formula: R' = R + K × G × (W − We), We = 1 / (1 + 10^(−dr / 400)), dr = R_home − R_away + home (none at a neutral venue); W is 1, ½ or 0, a match level after extra time a draw

start.rule: A team starts at 1500, or at 1300 when its first match in the results is in a year after 1930: every women's side starts at 1300.

k.note: The men's seasons' constants with the women's tournaments' names: the Olympic tournament, a full international one for women, weighs as the World Cup does, as in FIFA's women's ranking; the Olympic qualifying tournaments as qualifiers; the invitational tournaments (the Algarve Cup and others) and the unofficial championships before 1991 as every other match (30).

elo.goals: G is 1 for a margin of 0 or 1, 1.5 for 2, 1.75 for 3 and 1.75 + (N − 3) / 8 for N of 4 or more
elo.date: The ratings the day after the final: every match up to and including the final's day

strength.rule: T = best − perHundredElo × (E_best − E) / 100: E is the nation's Elo, E_best the best Elo among the teams that played in the four years before.
strength.calibration: best is the strongest built-in women's nation's strength (EA FC 27, 2026/27: Spain 88). 3.2 points per 100 Elo is the men's seasons' line: it gives the game's football model, which women's football plays, Elo's expected score within 0.0015 for gaps of 50 to 300 Elo.
